abilities.name: Devotion
abilities.text:
Uther's Basic Abilities grant 25 Armor to allied Heroes, and 15 to Uther, for 2 seconds.

Eternal Vanguard

Upon dying, Uther becomes an Invulnerable spirit for up to 8 seconds. While in spirit form, Uther can heal allies with Flash of Light for 230.

abilities.name: Holy Light
abilities.text: Heal target allied Hero for 362 Health. When used on a target other than Uther, also heal Uther for 181 Health.

abilities.name: Holy Radiance
abilities.text: Heal all allied Heroes and Minions in a line for 194 Health, dealing 177 damage to enemies.

abilities.name: Hammer of Justice
abilities.text: Deal 109 damage and Stun the target for 1 second.

abilities.name: Divine Shield
abilities.text: Make an allied Hero Invulnerable and increase their Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Divine Storm
abilities.text: Deal 170 damage and Stun nearby enemies for 1.75 seconds.

1.name: Silver Touch
1.text:
Quest: Reduce damage from Heroic sources with Devotion.

Reward: After reducing damage 40 times, Holy Light's Mana cost is reduced from 80 to 60.

Reward: After reducing damage 80 times, Holy Light's Mana cost is reduced to 40, and its range is increased by 50%.

1.name: Wave of Light
1.text:
Quest: Damage or heal Heroes 60 times with Holy Radiance.

Reward: Increase the duration of Devotion by 0.5 seconds.

Passive: Damaging or healing Heroes with Holy Radiance refunds 5 Mana and reduces its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

1.name: Hammer of the Lightbringer
1.text:
Quest: Basic Attack enemies 75 times.

Reward: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Hammer of Justice by 1.5 seconds.

Passive: Basic Attacks restore 1.5% of Uther's maximum Mana.

4.name: Holy Shock
4.text: Activate to deal 145 damage to the target enemy, and gain the self-healing benefits of Holy Light. Shares a cooldown with Holy Light.

4.name: Pursuit of Justice
4.text: Hammer of Justice increases Uther's Movement Speed by 25% for 3 seconds.

4.name: Holy Fire
4.text: Deal 13 damage per second to nearby enemies. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes increase this damage by 20% for 3 seconds. This can stack up to 3 times.

7.name: Armor of Faith
7.text: Being Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced grants Uther 90 Mana and causes Holy Light's cooldown to recharge 200% faster for 6 seconds. This effect has a 20 second cooldown.

7.name: Guardian of Ancient Kings
7.text: Healing a Hero with a Basic Ability that is Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced grants them 50 Armor for 3 seconds.

7.name: Hand of Protection
7.text: Activate to make target ally Unstoppable for 1 second. Cannot be cast on Uther. Basic Attacks reduce Hand of Protection's cooldown by 5 seconds.

10.name: Divine Shield
10.text: Make an allied Hero Invulnerable and increase their Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

10.name: Divine Storm
10.text: Deal 170 damage and Stun nearby enemies for 1.75 seconds.

13.name: Blessed Champion
13.text: For the next 5 seconds after using Holy Light, Uther's Basic Attacks heal him and nearby allied Heroes for 15% of the total amount healed by Holy Light.

13.name: Well Met
13.text: When used against Heroes, Hammer of Justice reduces the target's Movement Speed and damage dealt by 25% for 3 seconds.

13.name: Spell Shield
13.text:
Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

16.name: Beacon of Light
16.text: Uther receives 125% bonus self-healing when targeting others with Holy Light. This bonus is increased to 250% while he is below 50% Health.

16.name: Tyr's Deliverance
16.text: Increase the damage and healing of Holy Radiance by 10%. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes cause Uther's next cast of Holy Radiance to have its damage and healing increased by an additional 10%, stacking up to 7 times.

16.name: Benediction
16.text: Activate to reduce the Mana cost of Uther's next Basic Ability by 50 and its cooldown by 10 seconds.

20.name: Bulwark of Light
20.text: Divine Shield is also applied to all nearby allied Heroes and lasts 1 second longer.

20.name: Divine Hurricane
20.text: Divine Storm's radius is increased by 50% and its cooldown is reduced by 40 seconds.

20.name: Redemption
20.text:
After Eternal Vanguard ends, Uther revives at the spirit's location with 50% of his maximum Health.

This effect has a 180 second cooldown.

20.name: Divine Protection
20.text: Increase Devotion Armor to 50 and its duration by 0.5 seconds.
